d:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.
You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
c:
Elder Amberwind sent me a message about you and your exploits in Shen'dar Village. You are most welcome here, friend.
You have a strong aura, and you clearly have a resonance with the spirits. Fewer and fewer of us have the skysight of late, and Zephras needs those with the gift if we are to survive these trying times. I am glad you have found your way to me.
I look forward to further making your acquaintance.

d:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.
The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.
At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, friend.
p: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
c:
Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers I have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.
If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.

d:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... Thank you, friend.
If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... Our family.
He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
c:
Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.
I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall.
I'll never forget what you did for us, friend. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.

d:
Calling all anglers!
A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!
-- Gazlowe
p: What can I do for ya, traveler?
c:
Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!" all the time?
I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
goblin-male

d:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.
We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.
c:
So now you see? There is a world of knowledge and untapped potential outside of Skywall. This will never stop being our home, but I've come to believe that the path to our salvation lies below. We must travel to Azeroth and gain the power and means to save Zephras Isle. This is the way.
Will you have the courage to join us when the time comes?

d: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the friend above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... And beyond.
c:
So do you now see? Rediscovering the ancient magic of our forebears is the key to unlocking the secrets of Zephras Isle and securing our future, but in order to save our home, we must rediscover what we've lost these past millennia.
Azeroth is the key. The Kirin Tor will show us the way.
While we make ready to leave, you should check in with the other members of the High Order here in Valanaar. Most of them have tasks that they could use help from one such as yourself to see completed.

d:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.
One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.
If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
c: The satchel lying before you has a few specks of what appears to be dried blood on the flap. Studying the stain, you notice that the flap also has a name embroidered onto it. It reads "Fillion Flamebreeze".

d:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.
Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
p: The High Order do not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
c:
That is quite the haul of talons you've brought me. I cannot wait to dig into this!
Thank you for your service to the High Order, adventurer.

d:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.
Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
nightelf-female
c: Thank you. Let me see...

d:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
nightelf-female
p: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
c: I see... These gills appear to be healthy, for now. But we must not be complacent.

d:
The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.
The Defias have seized the mines of Westfall and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.
nightelf-female
c: Well done, friend. But I fear the source of the poison may lie somewhere else...

d:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.
I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?
Please travel to Moonbrook, friend, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
nightelf-female
c: What is all this?

d:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.
Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
nightelf-female
c: Need something blown up?
gnome-female

d:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...
gnome-female
c: This is a great start! Now to tie it all together... And add a little extra zing...

d:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
gnome-female
c: Hmm... Looking for something specific, are you?
human-male

d:
You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.
If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.
Oh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.
human-male
p: Did you get a remote detonator? A normal one simply won't do!
c: Great--that's exactly what we need!
gnome-female

d: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
gnome-female
p: Were your efforts in Stormwind fruitful?
c: I'm glad you've returned, friend.
nightelf-female

d:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
nightelf-female
p: Everything rests on you now, friend.
c: So you found the forge, and planted the bomb... Only one thing remains to be done.
